lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Ti4Mo4O16 (SrTi2Mo2O8) is tetragonal, space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Mo and Ti centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, alongside Sr in a 16-neighbor environment. Corner-sharing between MoO6 and TiO6 octahedra is observed, with additional corner and edge sharing between MoO6 and Sr polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
